evidence: Scope: Phase B kit code (d6f4369): reader_contract, document_viewer, pdf/word/sheets/slides/text controllers; kit pubspec deps

New tests: document_viewer_test 'reopens when the path changes', 'a load that outlives the viewer is dropped'; kit flutter test 55/55

optional: SpreadsheetController zoom does not rescale the current scroll offset, so the view drifts on zoom (pre-existing behaviour carried from the app)
